steps.description: poll https://relay.ferryx.dev/healthz every 5s for 180s and print "<unix ms> <http code>" lines
steps.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$end=(Get-Date).AddSeconds(180); while((Get-Date) -lt $end){ $t=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(); $c=(curl.exe -s -o NUL -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 4 https://relay.ferryx.dev/healthz); Write-Output \"$t $c\"; Start-Sleep -Seconds 5 }"

steps.description: stop the primary relay for 120s, then start it again
steps.command: date +%s%3N; sudo systemctl stop ferryx-relay.service; sleep 120; sudo systemctl start ferryx-relay.service; date +%s%3N
